data.name: Ruins of Aloryith
data.detailed_description:
EVERY SWING COMMITS

Ruins of Aloryith is a stylized third-person action roguelite built around deliberate, player-controlled combat.

Take up sword and shield as the Captain of the Dawnsworn and cut through hordes overrunning a corrupted Sun Temple. Chain heavy melee attacks, raise your shield against incoming danger, dodge through pressure, and unleash powerful active abilities when they matter most.

BUILD A DIFFERENT FIGHT EACH RUN

Defeat enemies, gather experience, and choose from three modifiers whenever you level up. Increase your speed, reach, survivability, and damage - or transform your abilities into increasingly destructive tools to help purge the corruption of the ancient temple.

SURVIVE THE ESCALATION

Each wave brings greater numbers and mounting pressure. Read enemy attacks, carve a path through the horde, and prepare for brutal boss encounters that test everything your build has become.

Learn when to attack, when to defend, and when one more committed swing can turn the fight.

  • Deliberate sword-and-shield combat

  • Player-triggered abilities

  • Run-changing modifier choices

  • Escalating enemy waves and boss finales

  • Premium single-player experience with no microtransactions or battle pass

  • Hand-crafted by a solo developer

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 22H2, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 6 GB / Radeon RX 6600 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 / Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
